name: next-up
description: When a turn ends, suggests up to three next prompts from the conversation and your open GitHub issues, pull requests and Linear issues.

github.title: GitHub
github.description: What to read from the current repository through the gh CLI: open issues and pull requests (default), issues only, or nothing.

linear.title: Linear
linear.description: Read your open Linear issues through the connected Linear MCP server (default), or nothing.

linearServer.title: Linear server
linearServer.description: The Linear MCP server's name as /mcp lists it. Empty (default): tries "claude.ai Linear", "Linear" and "linear".

linearProject.title: Linear project
linearProject.description: Only issues in this Linear project (name, identifier or slug). Empty (default): all your open issues.
